Class GiftCard

java.lang.Object
GiftCard
public class GiftCard extends Object
A gift card of a brand, with a credit that can be spent in a shop.

A card is created active. While it is active its credit can be spent (partially or all at once), recharged (only if the card is rechargeable) and transferred to another rechargeable card of the same brand. Once the card is blocked it can no longer be used: the remaining credit can only be recovered, one time.

      public void spend(double money)

    • sameBrand

      public static boolean sameBrand(GiftCard a, GiftCard b)
      Checks whether two cards belong to the same brand.

      The method is static because it compares the two cards passed as parameters and does not use the card it is called on: call it as GiftCard.sameBrand(a, b).

      Parameters:
      a - the first card
      b - the second card
      Returns:
      true if the two cards have the same brand, false otherwise

    • blockCard

      public void blockCard()
      Blocks the card. A blocked card cannot be used to spend, recharge or transfer credit any more. Nothing happens if it is already blocked.

    • recoverMoney

      public double recoverMoney()
      Recovers the money left on a blocked card. The credit is returned and set to 0, so it can be recovered only once.
      Returns:
      the recovered credit, or 0 if the card is still active

    • recharge

      public void recharge(double money)
      Adds money to the credit of the card. The recharge is made only if the card is rechargeable, active and the amount is positive; otherwise nothing happens.
      Parameters:
      money - the amount to add

    • transferTo

      public void transferTo(GiftCard b)
      Moves all the credit of this card to another card. The transfer is made only if:
      • the two cards are different objects;
      • both cards are active;
      • this card has some credit;
      • the two cards have the same brand;
      • the card that receives the money is rechargeable.
      Otherwise nothing happens.
      Parameters:
      b - the card that receives the credit
